SECTION 1

* Young people are frustrated because older generations criticize them for spending money on things like holidays or meals instead of saving every penny for a house.

* House prices in the UK have gotten so high and banks are lending less money, making it nearly impossible for young people to buy homes.

* The writer feels trapped in a cycle where they must rent forever, giving all their money to landlords who then complain about young people being irresponsible.

* Young workers under 25 face wage discrimination - they get paid less than older workers for doing the exact same job (as low as £5.60 per hour for 18-20 year olds).

* A 24-year-old working full-time might only earn £14,500 per year, and many young people are stuck with unstable zero-hours contracts where work isn't guaranteed.
